measurement_protocol.audio: Pull and independently decode every complete mono PCM16 WAV; verify hash, frame count, rate, duration, non-silence, and no clipping
measurement_protocol.callback_boundary: synthesis start to first non-empty callback; no playback
measurement_protocol.memory: 10 ms in-process sampled phase peak PSS/RSS plus phase-boundary PSS/RSS and cumulative process VmHWM
measurement_protocol.timing_boundary: System.nanoTime around only the sherpa synthesis call
